sonnet.problem: The card says Nebuzaradan finds Jeremiah at Ramah. Verse 1 says only that he released Jeremiah at Ramah, having found him bound. It does not say where he found him, so the card fixes a detail the text leaves open.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

sonnet.problem: Card 8 already tells the baker that Nebuzaradan says Jeremiah can return to Gedaliah and stay with him. That gives away the right answer, 'To Gedaliah at Mizpah', before this choice card is asked.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: Nothing earlier in the stop sets up Gedaliah's oath or his words about serving the Chaldeans. The statement itself contains the whole fact, so the baker can only guess. Card 5 then retells the same fact right after.
sonnet.rule: The check: could a thoughtful baker who has only seen the earlier cards make a reasoned pick? If the only way to get it right is luck, give the story card more context or ask a different question.
